mainText: Hello, Verona! At 9 AM, here is today's balanced dish: expect overcast skies and 57 degrees along the Military Ridge State Trail. Note that an air quality alert is in effect today with a moderate AQI of 55.

City news highlights that curbside refuse and recycling are contracted with Pellitteri Waste Systems, offering weekly trash pick-up and biweekly recycling. Residents can also use drop-off sites on Range Trail and Investment Court, or consult the online Waste Wizard tool for item disposal guidance.

Looking at upcoming events, you can drop in for Yoga at Insight Wellness today. Tomorrow brings multiple trivia options including Hop Haus Brewing, Quizmasters Trivia at Lake Lou-ee, and Dream Day Trivia at Paddy Mac's, followed by ART House 360 community events on Thursday.
In police news, on Wednesday, October 22nd, officers responded to a vehicle crash involving a Metro Bus on West Verona Avenue near Todd Street, where one driver was cited for failing to yield.
At Culver's, doors open today at 10:00 AM featuring today's flavor of the day, Peanut Butter Fudge Brownie.
